newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Loraine sees marginal Q2 output increase.
newsitem.headline: Loraine sees marginal Q2 output increase.

text.p: Loraine Gold Mines Ltd said on Tuesday that any production increases in the three months to end-June, 1997, would be marginal as a result of numerous public holidays and ventilation problems in the mine.
Loraine, part of Avgold Ltd, on Tuesday reported a first quarter loss of 4.96 million rand from the 5.42 million profit in the three months to end-December.
Gold production also declined to 1,449 kg from 1,534 kg in the previous quarter.
"In addition to the numerous public holidays, ventilation constraints exacerbated by highly seasonal temperatures also affected gold production.
"The board has indicated that production increases, if any, for the quarter ending June 1997, will be marginal," the company said.
Avgold said on Tuesday that following the formation of Avgold Ltd, the reporting of the company's results had changed substantially.
It said some changes -- especially the change from appropriation to amortisation of capital expenditure -- have resulted in significant difference of reporting.

"The other major change was as a result of the divisional structure of Avgold, compared with the previous structure of separate listings of each operation, which carries significant tax implications," Avgold said.
